name: Hathras
registryAssessment: The official District Hathras land-records page identifies the local land-record computer room and directs users to Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh. The official UP Bhu-Naksha viewer and Hathras-specific government digitization dashboard establish a relevant state/local cadastral-map service, but no safe native parcel identity and polygon were independently retrieved.

queries.query: Hathras Uttar Pradesh official land records cadastral map parcel Bhu Naksha
queries.result: Found the official District Hathras land-records page, the Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh portal, the official UP Bhu-Naksha viewer, and the Hathras cadastral-map digitization dashboard.

queries.query: हाथरस उत्तर प्रदेश भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा आधिकारिक
queries.result: Found the Hindi District Hathras land-records page, the UP Bhulekh portal, the UP Bhu-Naksha viewer, and the Hathras-specific digitization report. The accessible official material did not expose a safe parcel ID plus polygon for the WUP point.

officialSources.role: District Hathras, Government of Uttar Pradesh official land-records service page
officialSources.observation: Identifies the land-record computer room at the Collectorate and directs citizens to UP Bhulekh; this is local registry/service evidence, not parcel-vector evidence.

officialSources.role: Government of Uttar Pradesh cadastral-map digitization and georeferencing dashboard
officialSources.observation: The Hathras tehsil row reports 257 linked villages and 282 geo-referenced villages/mapsheet indicators with five remaining geo-reference entries; the report is aggregate status evidence and contains no individual parcel geometry.

officialSources.role: Current Uttar Pradesh Government/NIC Bhu-Naksha public viewer
officialSources.observation: Current HTML and JavaScript were fetched. The application identifies state code 09, hierarchy labels District/Tehsil/Village, and the public server host upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver.

officialSources.role: Board of Revenue, Uttar Pradesh official land-record portal
officialSources.observation: Describes public Bhulekh records and links land-record/map-related services; no owner, address, titleholder, tax, contact, or personal fields were requested or retained.

viewerRoute.safeNativeIdentityObservation: No anonymous plot response was obtained, so no native parcel identity or field name is asserted.

geometryDecision.reason: No bounded anonymous response containing a safe native parcel identifier and full polygon was obtained. The exact WUP point [27.5960398715243, 78.0517222203948] was preserved and not shifted. A viewer route miss or unavailable endpoint is not treated as citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh Bhu-Naksha public viewer and Hathras district/tehsil cadastral digitization status.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service existence, Hathras aggregate digitization status, viewer state code and hierarchy labels were verified. Parcel API schema, CRS, exact-point containment, native identity and citywide open polygon coverage were not verified.
